messages:
Kevin (Sales): FYI Medirev's security team came back with more asks for the POC: they want proof of ingestion to their SIEM, key-management provenance (KMS/HSM origin + rotation history), and explicit proof that POC keys were revoked and data streams stopped after the trial. They also asked for documented retention settings and deletion evidence. Can we produce this for a Hosted POC?
Sofia (Eng): Hosted can cover most of that. We emit admin audit events for key ops (create/rotate/revoke) and per-request logs include request_id, model, token counts, and source_ip. Retention is 180 days by default; we can produce a 90-day scoped export for the POC window.
Ravi (Security): Two things: 1) they want a signed attestation (PDF) that explains redaction policy and control owners; 2) a tamper-evident export for rotation/revoke events (csv preferred). For Hosted we can stamp exports with a SHA256 hash and include the hash in the attestation. For Dedicated/Private we can offer CMK details but that requires an MOU.
Lena (SE): Operationally we support streaming to Splunk HEC, S3 (customer-owned bucket), and syslog (via our syslog-gateway). Splunk HEC example payload we send: 
```
POST https://hec.example.com/services/collector/event/1.0
Authorization: Splunk <HEC_TOKEN>
{ "event": {"ts":"{{ts}}","request_id":"{{request_id}}","model":"redwood-qa","user":"redwood:api_key:abc","source_ip":"{{ip}}"}}
```
If they want deletion proof, we run a revoke job and include the revoke-event-id + SHA256(export) in the final bundle.
poc-bot: Provisioned medirev-poc-hosted-01 (expires 2026-05-02) :white_check_mark:
Sofia (Eng): For the rotation/revoke CSV we redact secret material and only include key_id, op, actor, ts, job_id, old_key_hash, new_key_hash, ticket_ref. Example CSV line: key_67890,rotate,carol@medirev,2026-03-15T12:04:33Z,rotjob-8823,sha256:abcd...,sha256:ef01...,INC-7789
Ravi (Security): Also confirm whether Medirev requires customer-managed CMKs. If they do, we must exchange an MOU and validate the key policy; for Private we can reference the CMK ARN in the questionnaire: arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111222333444:key/abcd-ef01.
Kevin (Sales): They said "prefer CMK" but will accept Hosted export for the first demo. They still want assurance that keys will be revoked at the end and the logs exported.
Lena (SE): Network & delivery checklist for them to provide: 1) Splunk HEC URL + token *or* S3 bucket ARN + write role (we support cross-account write role), 2) allowed egress IPs (we'll give a short list), 3) desired retention window and timezone for daily exports.
Sofia (Eng): For the signed attestation Ravi mentioned, we can include: SOC 2 references (control IDs), description of rotation automation (cron worker + SSO identity), redaction policy, and the export SHA256. I'll produce the export and a PDF summary once we get delivery target.
Ravi (Security): I'll draft attestation language and include a short appendix on redaction: "we provide hashes of replaced secrets, never plaintext; operator identity comes from Okta SSO and is recorded in audit events." Also will list control owners.
Kevin (Sales): Timeline: Medirev wants the evidence bundle by EOD Thursday. Can the export + attestation be ready?
Sofia (Eng): Yes, provided Medirev gives Splunk HEC endpoint or S3 creds by tomorrow noon. If not, we can upload to a secure SFTP with a signed receipt.
Lena (SE): I'll prepare a README that maps fields to questionnaire items and include a small AWS KMS policy snippet example they can use if they set up a cross-account CMK: 
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/RedwoodWriteRole"},"Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey*"],"Resource":"*"}
  ]
}
```
Kevin (Sales): Great. Action items: Sofia -> run POC export (90-day window) and produce CSV + JSONL daily logs; Ravi -> attestation + control refs; Lena -> README + delivery configs. I'll request Splunk/S3 info from carol@medirev.com and confirm CMK preference.
Ravi (Security): One more ask from legal: any penetration test summary or third-party audit that covers our logging and key management? We can share redacted test summary and SOC2 report excerpt.
Sofia (Eng): We have the SOC2 report excerpt and can pull a redacted pen-test summary. Will bundle those into the evidence zip.
Kevin (Sales): Awesome. I'll update Medirev and push for creds. Thanks team :thumbsup:
